name: agent://02-planner-issue-contract
observations: Planner requires Issue Breakdown in every plan.
Planner enforces issue ID format ISS-<epic>-<nnn>.
Planner blocks completion when issue task coverage is missing in Planka.

name: agent://03-analyst-issue-contract
observations: Analyst requires issue-scoped analysis mapping.
Analyst findings must be grouped by issue IDs.
Analyst Planka exit gate requires issue-ID evidence in tasks/comments.

name: agent://04-architect-issue-contract
observations: Architect enforces issue-aware architecture review under Release -> Epic -> Issue hierarchy.
Architecture findings must include issue coverage mapping to ISS-<epic>-<nnn> IDs.
Planka architecture tasks/comments require issue-ID evidence before completion.

name: agent://05-security-issue-contract
observations: Security agent enforces issue-scoped security controls under Release -> Epic -> Issue hierarchy.
Security requirements and findings include issue coverage mapping for ISS-<epic>-<nnn> IDs.
Planka exit verification requires issue IDs in security tasks and verdict comments.

name: agent://06-critic-issue-contract
observations: Critic agent enforces issue-granularity quality checks for plans under Release -> Epic -> Issue hierarchy.
Critique findings should be linked to ISS-<epic>-<nnn> issue IDs where applicable.
Planka exit verification requires issue-ID evidence in critique tasks and summary comments.

name: agent://07-implementer-issue-contract
observations: Implementer executes work in issue-sized units under Release -> Epic -> Issue hierarchy.
Implementation handoff must include issue-level completion evidence for ISS-<epic>-<nnn> IDs.
Planka exit validation requires issue IDs in implementation tasks/comments when issue decomposition exists.

name: agent://08-code-reviewer-issue-contract
observations: Code Reviewer maps findings and verdict evidence to issue IDs under Release -> Epic -> Issue hierarchy.
Review tasks/comments include issue coverage for ISS-<epic>-<nnn> IDs when issue decomposition exists.
Planka exit validation enforces issue evidence in verdict comments and review tasks.

name: agent://09-qa-issue-contract
observations: QA maps test coverage and regression evidence to issue IDs under Release -> Epic -> Issue hierarchy.
QA verdict requires issue-level pass/fail roll-up before marking QA Complete.
Planka exit verification enforces issue-ID task/comment evidence for QA completion.

name: agent://10-uat-issue-contract
observations: UAT validates acceptance outcomes at issue granularity under Release -> Epic -> Issue hierarchy.
UAT verdict and release recommendation must include issue-level roll-up evidence for ISS-<epic>-<nnn> IDs.
Planka completion checks require issue coverage in UAT tasks and verdict comments when issue decomposition exists.

name: agent://11-devops-issue-contract
observations: DevOps enforces release readiness using issue roll-up evidence under Release -> Epic -> Issue hierarchy.
Epic readiness matrix includes issue-level accepted/failed/deferred status for release gating.
Deployment comments and readiness artifacts require issue roll-up traceability before release completion.

name: agent://12-retrospective-issue-contract
observations: Retrospective synthesizes lessons by issue clusters under Release -> Epic -> Issue hierarchy.
Retrospective findings include issue-level roll-up feedback for future workflow improvements.
Completion evidence requires issue-cluster insights in retrospective summary comments and artifacts.

name: agent://13-pi-issue-contract
observations: Process Improvement analyzes issue-level metrics and roll-up outcomes under Release -> Epic -> Issue hierarchy.
Process-improvement recommendations must preserve issue evidence gates across agent workflows.
PI completion evidence includes issue-pattern improvements linked to workflow artifacts.
